drums.description: Funk rock instrumental, The track features a syncopated, slap-style electric bass line that locks with a tight, dry drum kit, A clean-toned electric guitar plays percussive, muted 16th-note scratches and staccato chords, A second electric guitar provides melodic lead lines with a slight overdrive and wah-wah filter, The arrangement is centered around a repetitive groove with occasional drum fills and cymbal accents, The tempo is 110 BPM in the key of E minor Publish

vocals.description: Rumba flamenca with a modern pop production, The arrangement features multiple layers of nylon-string acoustic guitars performing percussive rasgueado strumming and syncopated melodic fills, A prominent electric bass follows a rhythmic salsa-influenced pattern, Percussion consists of a cajón providing the primary backbeat, complemented by handclaps (palmas) and a subtle drum kit with a crisp snare, Male lead vocals are delivered with a traditional flamenco rasp and melismatic flourishes, supported by group backing vocals in a call-and-response style, The tempo is approximately 105 BPM in the key of A minor, A bridge section features a distorted electric guitar solo with heavy wah-wah filtering and bluesy bends, followed by a rhythmic breakdown with vocal ad-libs and percussive guitar taps Publish
